messages:
Lena: Microwave etiquette poll — quick vote: do you nuke for 30s or 90s? Also found a jar labeled 'Sneeze Fund' on the counter. Who does that belong to? :shrug:
Ava: 30s for most stuff. Unless it's leftover lasagna, then you get my blessing for >60s. Who even names jars :joy:
Marcus: 90s for soup. Jar is probably Janine's revenge campaign. :eyes:
Priya: Pro tip: cover your food. Less splatter = fewer passive-aggressive notes. :chef:
Diego: Also quick kudos to @Sam for restocking napkins yesterday — saved my keyboard. :tada:
Sam: Haha glad it helped! No one should suffer for soup splatter. :blush:
ops-bot: Reminder: kitchen rule #3 — if you make a mess, clean it. This is an automated friendly nudge. :robot_face:
Lena: New office anthem idea: hum a 3-note jingle while you wait for the microwave. Winner gets a mystery sticker. Vote by reacting: :one: = 30s jingle, :two: = 90s aria.
Marcus: :one: I will hum with dramatic flair. Also proposing a microphone stand — for authenticity. :microphone:
Ava: :two: but only if it's opera-level dramatic. Also, can we formalize the 'sneeze jar' policy? If you sneeze near snacks you owe a cookie. :cookie:
Priya: Love the jingle idea. Also tiny (non-serious) config suggestion: set `reheat_mode=true` whenever you forget to cover. :laughing:
Lena: Tally so far — :one: 3, :two: 2. Implementing 30s jingle tomorrow at 3pm in the kitchen. Prize: one mystery sticker and eternal bragging rights. GIF for morale: <https://giphy.com/microwave-jingle> :sparkles:
